name: breakhis-specialist-metric-v1

metric.case_representation: mean original field descriptors within each fitting case and magnification
metric.centering: same full46 equal-case per-view raw center for both heads
metric.normalization: L2 before and after bounded diagonal scaling; epsilon1e-12
metric.objective: same-view cross-case class-balanced leave-anchor-case-out density cross-entropy on case means; class densities divide by remaining class case count; anchor weights1/(K*n_class); mean over four views

router_policy: inherit exact prior selected UNI dual temperature; fixed >=0.5 malignant; no threshold fitting
identity_policy: replay accepted selected UNI dual validation probabilities within1e-10, labels and metric integers exactly; bypass scaling and re-normalization for identity
fitting_evaluation: in-sample learned metric with whole query omitted from density support and support centering; metric trained on fitting query labels
validation_policy: fitting-only learned metrics, centers and density support; validation and excluded cases never train metric
family_selection: all four prespecified arms reported; no validation hyperparameter or checkpoint selection; choosing an arm is an adaptive reused-validation choice
interpretation: bounded supervised per-head feature geometry on frozen UNI2-h, after adaptive reader choice; standard metric learning hypothesis, case-mean training and field-level inference differ; no novelty or95 guarantee; same original role/mask evaluation; no fresh final clinical test
primary_comparison: both versus identity on each validation arrangement
technical_smoke: two full200-step fitting-only head optimizations on812/trial1, then first two fitting queries; no validation scoring
